messages:
Maya S: getting repeated pgateway-sidecar alerts in ap-sg-1, p95 remote_write latency jumping, and prometheus is buffering. :eyes:
Maya S: stack: prometheus -> sidecar -> remote_write proxy -> cortex cluster
Maya S: any quick checks before paging infra?
Ryan K: ran into this earlier in canary — often DNS stalls cause sidecar scrape timeouts and kvcache replay. can you paste scrape duration graph?
Maya S: https://grafana.local/d/abcd/scrape-durations?orgId=1&panelId=7 — p99 shows 45s spikes, scrape_timeout is 30s so sidecar is retrying and buffering a bunch
Anita P: logs from sidecar show repeated "lookup exporter.internal.svc: no such host" followed by connection resets.
Devon L: that smells like node-local DNS flapping + natgw ephemeral port exhaustion. but also saw label explosion from ephemeral job_id on GPU exporters
Maya S: grabbing logs now:
```
kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-sidecar-0 | tail -n 50
2026-03-18T02:11:23Z WARN remote_write: retrying batch, reason: dial tcp: lookup exporter.internal.svc: i/o timeout
2026-03-18T02:11:24Z ERROR enqueue: drop samples, buffer full, tenant=tenant-gpu
```
Maya S: ops-bot just opened incident INC-7452 with link: https://incidents.local/INC-7452 :rotating_light:
Ryan K: quick mitigation options:
- increase prometheus.scrape_timeout? only masks DNS problem and could worsen overlap
- add relabeling to drop high-cardinality labels (pod_ip, pod_uid, gpu_uuid) at scrape time
- throttle exporter label explosion with relabel: replace or drop action
- short-term: lower retention for this tenant or scale sidecar replicas
Anita P: suggested relabel snippet to drop pod_uid & pod_ip:
```
- job_name: gpu-exporters
  static_configs:
  - targets: ['10.1.2.3:9100']
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ['__meta_kubernetes_pod_uid']
    action: drop
  - source_labels: ['__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip']
    action: drop
```
Devon L: also recommend adding a relabel to normalize exporter labels coming from the GPU driver, e.g. gpu_index -> gpu_index (keep) but drop pci_addr and full_device_path which create card spikes
Maya S: runbook step: I deployed the relabel drop to staging. promtool config-check passed. applying to ap-sg-1 in 5m.
Ryan K: for DNS, check node-local-dns metrics and kube-dns forwarding QPS. if node-local saturating, we should increase stubDomains cache TTL or increase node-local replicas
Anita P: observed natgw SNAT reuse counters high for ap-sg-1; ephemeral port exhaustion leads to RSTs which look like DNS timeouts. opening ticket with cloud infra to add larger ephemeral port range for the NATGW pool.
Maya S: after staging relabel push, p95 scrape duration drops to ~2s in staging, remote_write buffer pressure decreased. staging tenant shows 30% fewer series.
Devon L: can we add a temporary alert to surface label-cardinality growth per job and per-tenant? new rule: increase if unique_series_rate > 1k/min for 5m
Maya S: logged follow-ups: 1) push relabel to prod in 10m 2) cloud infra ticket for natgw port range 3) add cardinality growth alert 4) investigate exporter causing pci_addr labels 5) docs update for exporters to avoid dynamic unique labels
Maya S: thanks all, keeping watch on buffer metrics. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
